source: Owner direct chat following the situational tactics proposal
decision: Implement the proposed first playable tactical result: one enemy with prompt known-threat reacquisition and useful protected observation after losing contact, with a minimal coordinator/intent seam for later group extension.
controller_slicing: Create a bounded early MSQ-101 child on delivered MSQ-103 rather than claiming completion of the full CAI-03/04/05 packages. Use currently available sight evidence and collision/navigation capabilities. CAI-02 hearing/fire stimuli remains a separate next package; its absence must be explicit and cannot be hidden by fabricated sensory evidence.
scope: Implement position selection from actual retained geometry, reachable protected movement, useful approach-facing observation, bounded reassessment and fallback, and reduced redundant acquisition delays. Integrate with existing interruptible actions, physical authority, reset generations and observability.
execution: Use one Multica Unreal executor at Astra/max, standard/default speed, and one primary independent technical reviewer at max. Verify saved settings and native execution. Controller owns task administration, acceptance and local closure commit.
verification: Continue owner-only gameplay testing. Agents perform native build, focused source/pure checks and independent source review. Geometry inspection in the editor is allowed; no agent Play, simulated combat, firing or gameplay probes. Runtime tactical quality and combat feel remain owner judgement.
editor_lifecycle: Necessary controlled rebuild and editor reload are authorized. Confirm project, retained map, Play and dirty state before lifecycle changes; preserve unsaved assets and coordinate a newly active owner session.
later_scope: Two/three-member cooperation, full hearing/stimulus integration, Recast topology, suppression, health/lifecycle completion, smoke, traps and other equipment remain separate. This first task does not declare the existing larger packages complete or dispatch successors.
preservation: Preserve Config/DefaultEngine.ini and MeridianSquad.uproject owner edits, retained map/geometry, character sources, GASP/Mover authority, finite projectiles and world/bullet/rifle 0.25 versus hero 0.65 slowdown. Preserve all historical candidate manifests.
